description: This line plot illustrates the training and validation loss trends for two experimental setups, Ex1 and Ex2, over the course of training steps, as part of the RedWhale project on efficient continual pretraining of a Korean LLM. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to approximately 60,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2 × 10⁰ to 2 × 10¹, with labeled ticks at 2 × 10⁰, 3 × 10⁰, 4 × 10⁰, 6 × 10⁰, 10¹, 1.1 × 10¹, and 2 × 10¹. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Ex1 Loss” (solid blue line with blue circular markers) begins near 4.0 at step 0, drops sharply to approximately 2.2 by step 10,000, then gradually increases to about 3.5 by step 60,000. “Ex2 Loss” (solid teal line with teal circular markers) starts near 3.0, dips slightly to around 2.8 by step 15,000, then steadily rises to approximately 4.0 by step 60,000. “Ex1 Validation Loss” (dashed blue line with blue circular markers) begins near 5.0, drops to about 3.5 by step 10,000, then slowly climbs to roughly 5.5 by step 60,000. “Ex2 Validation Loss” (dashed teal line with teal circular markers) starts at approximately 20.0, drops steeply to around 5.0 by step 10,000, then gradually increases to about 7.0 by step 60,000. All lines show a general upward trend after an initial drop, with Ex2 Validation Loss exhibiting the highest initial value and steepest early decline.
